title: RAW manuscript constraint: frozen char/cheey synonymy makes one extensional l-constructor equate attested lchar/lcheey
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. IDEA501 gives char and cheey the same lettuce food-kind T. The admitted GDT928 packet contains 2 lchar and 13 lcheey occurrences. Under a newly declared extensional l+base hypothesis, the derived denotations must be identical before either is guessed. A whole-form or lexeme-sensitive rival need not preserve that equality. All 15 whole paragraphs and 1051 groups are retained; 490 types remain unassigned. No complete reading or test readiness. GDT929’s absent l-edge and GDT787’s WHOLE_ONLY limit remain binding.

design.mechanism: Extensional semantic congruence for two explicitly proposed initial-l constructions over already guessed synonymous whole bases.
design.unit: Exactly char, cheey, lchar and lcheey; all 15 owned ZL complete-paragraph occurrences of the latter two and available whole counterpart paragraphs.
design.contrast: One meaning-only constructor F with no spelling or occurrence side channel, versus two lexicalized whole outputs or a lexeme-sensitive constructor.
design.prediction: With the parent char=cheey identity unchanged, meaning(lchar)=F(T)=meaning(lcheey). Different derived types, referents or truth conditions are forbidden under the same arguments.
design.scope: Exploratory conditional consequence, not a proven morpheme, synonym or meaning. No new whole-paragraph authoring or execution.

contract.status: Written before any new lchar/lcheey whole-passage meaning authoring; after explicit metadata exposure. Not a blind preregistration.

frozen_inputs.denotation: The lettuce comparator named in the source; positive good-juiced contrast comes from the explicit C04 construction, not from the name itself.
The same lettuce food-kind as old char=LETTUCE. An explicitly counted new synonymous form, not a new plant or new physical serving.

parent.scope: The two copied full entries are exact. All other 501 values remain unchanged if later used; no clock-family meanings are borrowed.

observation_packet.status: Actual raw complete forms in previously admitted paragraphs. Exact prefixes are surface observations; morphology remains hypothesized. No new access or normalization.

fixed_semantic_equations: m(char)=T and m(cheey)=T are inherited unconfirmed 501 commitments.
F has one definition and only the base denotation as primary input.
Therefore m(lchar)=m(lcheey); this equality is fixed before either output is assigned.
why_this_changes_a_reading_decision: A future extension cannot independently assign lchar a substance/actor and lcheey a unrelated event just because separate paragraphs suggest them. It must retain one shared output or reject the joint morphology+synonym hypothesis. This removes one free lexical output and forbids later local rescue; it does not identify what the shared output means.

strongest_predecessor_limits.retained: All cheey/lcheey/sheey/lsheey forms are attested, but no fixed immediate context isolates an l-pair. The three ch/sh frames prove neither an l-operation nor this new char/cheey pair.
A strong 50-cell paradigm did not license free suffix-meaning transfer; the additive model beat both comparators in only 3/9 families. Whole-form residual is a serious rival.

Generic transparent composition lacked component meanings and override licenses. This card supplies two already guessed equal inputs plus actual complete extensions, not a universal transparency claim.

what_is_distinct: The prediction is equality forced by the parent’s own synonym choice, not a fresh suffix gloss, neighbor profile, matched-context rerun or universal one-edit rule. The actual output remains missing. Only a complete independently fixed reading could make the constraint discriminating.
selection_prerequisites: Supply complete existing readings containing both extended forms, with all raw groups and variants; do not read only the selected tokens.
Freeze one derived type/value and one constructor definition before testing another focal context; retain all prior conflicts.
If context is required, declare a different prospective model. No added context arguments, overrides or hidden lexeme IDs after a conflict.
Do not launch a 1051-group decoder project. Without a small complete existing reading binding both outputs, this remains missing meaning binding.

smallest_decision_note.positive: The bases and extensions occur, and the parent already chooses synonymy.
smallest_decision_note.unknown: Whether l marks a shared extensional constructor and what either extended whole means.
smallest_decision_note.meaningful_outcomes: Distinct fixed outputs reject the joint contract; equal outputs only retain it; unbound outputs mean untestable.
smallest_decision_note.budget: At most 20 minutes for a later manual fixed-reading compatibility review including evidence and publication. No simulator or new gloss inventory.

known_nonseparating_alternative: Synonymous content need not erase lexeme identity. F(lexeme,T) may distinguish char from cheey. This explicit residual rival is not evidence for the pure meaning-only model.
